h1: Sunset Park (Brooklyn 8th Avenue) Chinese-Language Legal Consultation
intro: Sunset Park is among the fastest-growing Chinese communities in New York, with many newer immigrant families and small businesses. The legal needs here are practical: splitting the books on a jointly run shop, construction payments, landlord and tenant problems, and property and inheritance arrangements within families. Everything is handled in Chinese, so you never need to bring someone along to translate.
